cc:Work.dc:title: Notification timing ecosystem
cc:Work.dc:description: EECS 4461 DEL03.1 ecosystem map. Source model and results are the verified DEL02 prototype.

g.text: The simulation tracks arrival and release minutes. Real iOS internals, user attention, urgency, and actions are outside its scope.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #42605c

g.text: Solid arrows trace the notification flow. The dotted arrow shows the design reference that motivates the comparison.
